description.value: The Cobble Hill Country Grocer is a full-service supermarket located just off Highway 1 at Cowichan Bay Road, part of a family-owned Vancouver Island chain operating since 1984. Opened in 1999, this store serves the communities of Mill Bay, Shawnigan Lake, Cobble Hill, and Duncan, making it a natural resupply stop for cyclists on the island corridor. It is known for its scratch bakery, bustling produce department, full deli and meat counter, and an on-site nutrition advisor.
